about: The probe reviewer's recorded fixtures for probe:p345 (docs/method/HOW-WE-BUILT-THIS.md rule 9). No run of probe:p345 existed when they were written, so each is composed in the exact shapes the run reads: the lines ios/TortieUITests/P316DriveUITests.swift prints (step, seq, a dump's elements with id, label and frame, a macs line's label, found and tabs) with what build/p345/probe-p345.mjs adds as it reads them (receivedAt, doors, records; a mark's markAt, markDoneAt, recordsAt and recordsAfter), and build/p345/sni-relay.mjs's connection log. `--grader-self-test` reads each drive through the SAME reader the run calls, then the grader, and each grader's readings straight; `want` is the verdict.
